description:
Make a new agent definition by copying a template folder, or check a definition folder. One op per call:
- copy: {"op": "new", "from": {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/templates/agent-fsm"}, "path": "defs/helper"}  (from can also be a folder path; path must not exist yet; relative paths start at your workspace)
- check: {"op": "check", "path": "defs/helper"}  (prints {"problems": [...]}; empty list = OK)
new only copies. Then edit the copy with your normal file tools (system.txt, tools.json, llm.json). To run it, use agents_children or agents_ctl.
Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, DefMissing, DefExists (pick another path), DefBad, DirectiveBad.

op.description: new = copy a template to a new definition folder, check = check a definition folder

from.description: new: the template folder to copy, as a directive like {"$env": "AOS_HOME", "$path": "/templates/agent-fsm"} or a folder path (relative to your workspace, or absolute)

path.description: new: the new definition folder (must not exist yet). check: the definition folder. Relative to your workspace, or absolute
